name: dataplatformlab
description: Query the post-trade data product (local DuckDB or Snowflake), run the tour's checks, build with dbt and read the code of DataPlatformLab, running in a WSL distribution.
long_description: Claude Desktop starts the DataPlatformLab MCP server inside a WSL distribution (wsl.exe) and talks to it over stdio. Queries open the warehouse read-only, or with target snowflake run one SELECT, SHOW or DESCRIBE on the Snowflake account as a read-only role (key-pair sign-in from ~/.snowflake/dpl.env inside WSL); the actions are a fixed list: the tour's checks, dbt commands and the pipeline.
